inlines.v: SERAPH'ICAL, 1. Pertaining to a seraph; angelic; sublime; as seraphic purity; seraphic fervor. 2. Pure; refined from sensuality. 3. Burning or inflamed with love or zeal. Thus St. Bonaventure was called the seraphic doctor.
